verdict.rationale: Mixpanel's own Warehouse Connectors sync data from Snowflake, BigQuery, Databricks, Redshift, and Postgres into Mixpanel. Mirror mode uses Snowflake Streams and Databricks Change Data Feed for ongoing change-tracked sync, which satisfies the warehouse-to-platform half of the story. Outbound, the Raw Event Export API offers high-volume JSONL export, but only as a pull API, with no documented continuous push into a warehouse. Missing for 10: evidence of continuous, managed event export into the user's warehouse; in-place querying of warehouse tables rather than syncing them in; independent or hands-on corroboration of connector reliability.
